description: Port of SQLFluff 4.4.0's PG02 (postgres.not_valid_foreign_key), force_enable=true: in PostgreSQL, an ALTER TABLE ADD CONSTRAINT FOREIGN KEY must include NOT VALID; anchor the ALTER TABLE statement start.

violation.message: ADD CONSTRAINT ... FOREIGN KEY should use NOT VALID, then VALIDATE CONSTRAINT separately, to avoid locking the table while validating existing rows.
